title: Yara and the Parish
author: Juniper Blackwood
blurb: Sebastian Yarrow, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
